description: Retarget a figure to a different page: re-lay the panels, keep the contents' own sizes.
phrases: fit this figure into a journal column
retarget a slide figure for print
change the page size and re-lay the panels

requires.note: the grid it was laid out to

returns: the reflowed scene to --out; the old and new page, on stderr

examples.output: lineart-scene: refusing: this scene has no panel grid, so there is nothing to reflow -- resizing the canvas alone would move the page and not its contents. `layout.panels` records the grid.

notes: GENERATED from `lineart_trace.scene.cli.verb_reflow` by `python3 -m lineart_trace.records`. Edit that docstring, not this file: a record written by hand is a second copy of a description that already exists beside the code, and the two drift silently.
